items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I received a telegram from Kansas City and Harlan Leonard needed a trombone player. So I left Texas to go to Kansas City and I joined Harlan Leonard there.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, those girls could really wail, the could wail just like the male band. They had a great band with rhythm. In later years, you've heard of the other girl bands, Ina Rae Hutton -- various -- female musicians make a great, great group.

Okay, how about -- I think actually before you went to New York you mentioned that you had gone to Texas. You played in Dallas. Just exactly when does that come along? Does that precede your going with Harlan Leonard -- could you tell us a little bit about that?
This is at a later time. It will come later. If we're going to tell you about sequence, this is a few more years later, after I came back from New York.
